children.name: Spirula
children.description: Spirula — a genus of ram's horn squid in the family Spirulidae.

children.name: Spirula spirula
children.description: Spirula spirula is a species of deep-water squid-like cephalopod mollusk. It is the only extant member of the genus Spirula, the family Spirulidae, and the order Spirulida. Because of the shape of its internal shell, it is commonly known as the ram's horn squid or the little post horn squid.
